Privacy Policy

Last updated: 12 June 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how HamaraSetu (operated by Sara Stack Labs, referred to as "we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our mobile application and related services (collectively, the "Service").

1. Information we collect

1.1 Information you provide

  • Account information: phone number, name, profile photo (optional)
  • Delivery information: delivery addresses, contact phone number, delivery instructions
  • Order information: items ordered, order history, ratings and reviews you submit
  • Payment information: we do NOT store card or bank details. Online payments are processed exclusively by Razorpay (an RBI-licensed payment gateway). We only receive a confirmation that the payment succeeded.
  • Communications: messages you send to our support team

1.2 Information collected automatically

  • Device information: device model, operating system, app version
  • Location: approximate location when you grant permission, to show nearby shops and enable delivery
  • Usage data: screens viewed, actions taken, crash reports (via Sentry)

2. How we use your information

  • To provide and improve the Service — show you nearby shops, enable ordering, track deliveries
  • To process payments through Razorpay
  • To send order status notifications (push notifications, SMS)
  • To respond to your support requests
  • To prevent fraud and ensure security
  • To comply with legal obligations

3. Sharing your information

We share your information only with the following parties, and only as necessary to provide the Service:

  • Shop owners and delivery partners involved in fulfilling your order — they see your name, delivery address, contact number, and order details
  • Razorpay for payment processing — subject to Razorpay's own privacy policy at razorpay.com/privacy
  • Service providers we rely on (Firebase by Google for backend infrastructure, Sentry for crash reporting, push notification services)
  • Law enforcement when required by valid legal process

We do NOT sell your personal information to third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.

4. Data retention

We retain your account information for as long as your account is active. Order history is retained for 7 years for tax and accounting purposes as required by Indian law. You may request deletion of your account at any time — see Section 6.

5. Data security

We use industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (HTTPS), Firebase Authentication, and server-side access controls. We follow the principle of least privilege — only employees who need access to your data for support purposes have it.

6. Your rights

You have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Correct inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your account and personal data
  • Withdraw consent for non-essential data processing
  • File a complaint with the relevant data protection authority

To exercise any of these rights, email us at sarastacklabs@gmail.com.

7. Children

The Service is not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.

8. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via in-app notification and update the "Last updated" date above. Continued use of the Service after such notice constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

9. Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, contact us at sarastacklabs@gmail.com.
